up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values (standard_relation = '=') for compounds tested against the target CHEMBL4296 (human sodium channel protein type 9 subunit alpha). Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment. Only include rows where the compound has a valid canonical_smiles and the associated document has at least one valid PubMed ID or DOI. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.activity_comment FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
